title: Expander
text: Dynamic range expander, 7 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough; {Ratio} sets the expansion ratio, {Threshold (dB)} sets the operation threshold, {Knee width (dB)} sets the transition area in the compression, {View static characteristic} sets the open static characteristic plot of dynamic range expander, {Attack time (s)} sets the time for applied gain to ramp up, {Release time (s)} sets the time for applied gain to ramp down, {Hold time (s)} sets the time during which applied gain holds, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input, {Output gain (dB)} sets the gain applied on each input sample, {Sidechain} enables sidechain input and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Gain applied to each input sample matrix

params.name: Ratio
params.values: Expansion ratio 5 (default) | scalar in the range 1 to 50 inclusive

params.name: Threshold (dB)
params.values: Operation threshold –10 (default) | scalar in the range –140 to 0 inclusive

params.name: Knee width (dB)
params.values: Transition area in the compression characteristic 0 (default) | scalar in the range 0 to 20

params.name: View static characteristic
params.values: Open static characteristic plot of dynamic range expander button

params.name: Attack time (s)
params.values: Time for applied gain to ramp up 0.05 (default) | scalar in the range 0 to 4 inclusive

params.name: Release time (s)
params.values: Time for applied gain to ramp down 0.2 (default) | scalar in the range 0 to 4 inclusive

params.name: Hold time (s)
params.values: Time during which applied gain holds steady 0.05 (default) | scalar in the range 0 to 4 inclusive

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Specify source of input sample rate on (default) | off

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input 44100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Output gain (dB)
params.values: Gain applied on each input sample off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
